rules.statement: The defendant's possession was not interrupted or disturbed within the ten years preceding the action, thus entitling him to a decree in his favor.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not know who is the Peris Sinho by whom he mentions an attempt was made to disturb him 'five or eight years ago,' and as to what Susey Pulle did when he 'tried to oust' defendant and the latter shot a man in 'regular riot.' No particulars are given. It may be that not a man ever set foot on the land itself, nor that the defendant was a loser of a not thereby."
